title: Forget Vectors at Play: Universal Input Perturbations Driving Machine Unlearning in Image Classification and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2412.16780v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU), which seeks to erase the influence of specific unwanted data from already-trained models, is becoming increasingly vital in model editing, particularly to comply with evolving data regulations like the "right to be forgotten". Conventional MU approaches are predominantly model-based, typically requiring retraining or fine-tuning the model's weights to meet unlearning requirements. In this work, we approach the MU problem from an input perturbation-based perspective, where the model weights remain intact throughout the unlearning process. We demonstrate the existence of a proactive input-based unlearning strategy, referred to forget vector, which can be generated as an input-agnostic data perturbation and remains as effective as model-based approximate unlearning approaches in both image classification and image generation. translated_title: 遗忘向量发挥作用：驱动图像分类与生成任务中机器遗忘的通用输入扰动
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘（MU）旨在消除特定不需要的数据对已训练模型的影响，在模型编辑中正变得日益重要，特别是为了遵守诸如“被遗忘权”等不断发展的数据法规。传统的机器遗忘方法主要基于模型，通常需要重新训练或微调模型权重以满足遗忘要求。在本工作中，我们从基于输入扰动的视角来处理机器遗忘问题，在整个遗忘过程中模型权重保持不变。我们证明了一种主动的基于输入的遗忘策略的存在，称之为“遗忘向量”（forget vector），它可以作为与输入无关的数据扰动生成，并且在图像分类和图像生成任务中与基于模型的近似遗忘方法同样有效。对于图像分类任务，我们证明了遗忘向量可以诱导有效的类（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为“遗忘向量”的通用输入扰动方法，无需修改模型权重，即可在图像分类与图像生成任务中实现与基于模型的遗忘方法同样有效的机器遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "forget vectors," universal input-agnostic perturbations that achieve machine unlearning as effectively as model-based approaches in both image classification and generation, while keeping model weights intact.
